subject: Request: accelerator credit waiver for Founders Lab cohort
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@founderslab.co>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: accelerator credits for March cohort

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Founders Lab was impressed by the latency numbers and the cost controls you showed. Quick ask: we onboard a cohort of ~18 early-stage startups every quarter and we typically negotiate a promotional credit arrangement with partners. For this cohort (kicks March 15) we were hoping Redwood could make an exception to the standard promotional pack and extend $30k in credits across the cohort (vs. your standard $10k/template).

The rationale: we commit to a co-marketing webinar and a short case study; two of the startups are in talks with SeedVault for follow-on funding (cc'ing Jacob Reed) so there's potential ARR upside. Is there someone on your side who can approve a one-time credit exception / expanded promo? If yes, what information you need (SOW, cohort list, POC emails)?

Appreciate your help — timing is tight.

Best,
Nora Patel
Partnerships Director
Founders Lab Accelerator

--
Attachment: FoundersLab_SOW_v3.pdf (application list redacted)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@founderslab.co>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credits for March cohort

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the SOW. Totally understand the timing. Quick answers up front: we can do cohort promotional credits beyond the standard pack but exceptions need approval from Sales Ops for the credit amount and from Revenue for the co-marketing commitment.

I've looped in Rishi (VP, Sales) to confirm whether $30k is feasible for a pilot partnership and to align on the co-marketing deliverable list. Could you share a short prioritized deliverables list (webinar date, case study deliverable, logo rights) and the cohort POC list? That will speed approvals.

If it helps, we have an interim option: offer $15k in credits + joint webinar in Q2, with an M&O (marketing & outcomes) clause that gives an additional $15k if two startups convert to paid plans within 6 months. That structure protects Redwood while sharing upside.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Fwd: Request: accelerator credits for March cohort — approval needed

Rishi / David — forwarding a request from Founders Lab (Nora). Summary: they asked for $30k in cohort credits in exchange for webinar + case study; cohort ~18 startups; potential lead gen via SeedVault. My recommended structure: $15k promo now + $15k contingent on 2 conversions within 6 months (M&O clause). Also include co-marketing commitments and a short SOW (attached).

Key considerations:
- ARR risk: we can cap max per-startup redemption and enforce token limits visible in Console.
- Procurement: they'd prefer a single SOW + DocuSign for faster onboarding.
- Reporting: we should require a simple conversion scoreboard (provided by Founders Lab) to trigger contingent credit.

Ask: can you approve the $15k up-front promo and the contingency structure (or do you want to propose a different split)? If yes, I'll send a brief MSA addendum and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa

Quick decision: I approve the pilot structure. Provide $15k up-front promo credits + $15k contingent on two startups converting to paid plans within six months. Conditions:
1) Per-startup cap of $3k in redeemable credits in the first 90 days (to prevent heavy early usage).
2) Written co-marketing plan with dates and deliverables (webinar date locked, one page case study within 90 days).
3) DocuSign SOW + M&O clause that specifies the conversion metric and verification method (HubSpot deal IDs or signed invoices).

Marissa — you have approval to send the DocuSign with the above conditions. Finance confirm this structure is a marketing promotion and will be expensed to Partnership programs; no change to standard billing flow needed.

Rishi Malhotra
